docs.visitor_identification_process: All visitors present government-issued photo ID at reception, are logged, and are issued a dated, visibly distinct temporary badge that expires at end of day and is surrendered on exit
docs.escort_policy: Visitors are escorted by an authorized employee at all times inside the cardholder data environment and are never left unattended near systems or media
docs.visitor_log_retention: Visitor logs (name, company, purpose, on-site employee, entry and exit times) retained for 12 months, exceeding the PCI DSS three-month minimum
